verdict.rationale: HMRC's GOV.UK guides are written in plain second-person language rather than statute text. Examples include "You'll need to register your company with Companies House", exact VAT thresholds with voluntary-registration and exception options, and walked-through Corporation Tax and Making Tax Digital sign-up sequences. The guides are also available in Welsh. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that founders find the guides followable; the evidence shows snippets rather than full numbered step-by-step flows for each task.
